scope: Research questions and data dependencies, not a set of completed analyses

existing_assets.label: ABS CPI
existing_assets.reuse: Australian price-year conversion; select appropriate series and period.
existing_assets.limitations: Directory presence verified; values, price basis, API operation and revision not audited.

existing_assets.label: Stats NZ CPI
existing_assets.limitations: No inflation values ingested or validated in this work.

existing_assets.label: ABS labour force and average weekly earnings
existing_assets.reuse: Labour-market covariates and earnings sensitivity scenarios.
existing_assets.limitations: Aggregate earnings are not a child-specific lifetime earnings trajectory or family exposure.

existing_assets.label: Stats NZ labour market statistics
existing_assets.limitations: Age, geography, seasonal adjustment and historical breaks require qualification.

existing_assets.label: Stats NZ household income and housing costs
existing_assets.reuse: Income/housing context and candidate distributional strata.
existing_assets.limitations: Existing metadata says exact ADE endpoint/codelists require live refresh; survey concepts and transition must be preserved.

existing_assets.label: Stats NZ population estimates
existing_assets.reuse: Candidate NZ denominators, once age/geographic coverage aligns.
existing_assets.limitations: Prefer the mortality source denominator for reproduced rates; never silently replace it with a national estimate.

existing_assets.label: AIHW MyHospitals archive extracts
existing_assets.reuse: General hospital utilisation/context; reuse source access infrastructure.
existing_assets.limitations: Payload paths present in Git tree, not downloaded or audited here. These do not establish paediatric mental-health demand, aftercare or individual linkage.

existing_assets.label: NZ Health Survey
existing_assets.reuse: Candidate health/access context where age scope permits.
existing_assets.limitations: Adult measures cannot be assigned to children; source values and youth eligibility not qualified.

existing_assets.label: Health Policy Atlas ANZ
existing_assets.reuse: Policy source provenance, applicability and dated exposure evidence.
existing_assets.limitations: Readme inspected, not a captured/validated youth policy corpus. Global policies remain outside ANZ atlas scope.

existing_assets.label: Value of Perspective / DCEA framework
existing_assets.limitations: Model validity, API integration, CHEERS compliance and current tests not independently verified; no child-health parameters inferred.

existing_assets.label: voiage
existing_assets.reuse: EVPI/EVPPI/EVSI/ENBS from qualified probabilistic model outputs.
existing_assets.limitations: DecisionAnalysis/ValueArray and ingestion documented; no runtime integration test performed. Experimental methods stay explicitly labelled.

existing_assets.label: Microcosting Health Workforce
existing_assets.reuse: Workforce costing logic, productive-time and unit-rate concepts.
existing_assets.limitations: Existing workbook values and institutional permissions not audited or copied; verify current jurisdiction awards and model assumptions.

existing_assets.label: Existing HF catalogue and source-packet archive
existing_assets.reuse: Existing metadata governance and immutable packet destinations.
existing_assets.limitations: Descriptions inspected; complete catalogue and revisions not read. No publication or collection mutation performed.

additional_data_needs.label: Mortality exports and original-source validation
additional_data_needs.granularity: jurisdiction × year × non-overlapping age band; sex only if source supplies it
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Source-specific geography/age/period/cause keys; no fuzzy country-name joins.
additional_data_needs.access: Public aggregates subject to source-specific rights; no raw payload available.
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Terms, exact assets, checksums, headers, count and denominator audit.

additional_data_needs.label: Age-specific survival and life tables
additional_data_needs.granularity: jurisdiction × year × age × sex if available
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Match age and year or justify interpolation/scenario.
additional_data_needs.access: Official statistical life tables; licence and historical coverage to verify.
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Period versus cohort assumptions; competing mortality and age at death uncertainty.

additional_data_needs.label: Dated policy and simulated entitlement panel
additional_data_needs.granularity: jurisdiction × effective date × eligible family/age type
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Exposure determined before outcome analysis; distinguish jurisdiction from publisher scope.
additional_data_needs.access: Public rules/indicators; model platform access may need approval.
additional_data_needs.owner: atlas-health-policy-anz for ANZ documents; open_social_data for numerical/global sources
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Legal applicability, implementation versus announcement, and independent extraction review.

additional_data_needs.label: Macroeconomic and social conditions
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Calendar/fiscal periods, constant/current prices, PPP basis, data vintage and native geography retained.
additional_data_needs.access: Public aggregate indicators; retain original source and modelled flags.
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Select and verify exact indicators, rights, measurement breaks and plausible causal adjustment set.

additional_data_needs.label: Intervention effects and implementation evidence
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Match population/comparator/outcome; transportability and evidence dependence assessed.
additional_data_needs.access: Primary studies, trial reports and implementation evaluations; author contact where needed.
additional_data_needs.owner: vop_poc_nz study evidence; source documents remain at canonical owner
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: No direct proportional translation of ideation/attempt effects into mortality effects without evidence.

additional_data_needs.label: Resource use and unit costs
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Physical resources separate from unit costs; currency, year, wage schedule and productive-time basis mandatory.
additional_data_needs.access: Public price sources plus authorised local costing; sensitive workbook stays governed.
additional_data_needs.owner: microcosting_healthworkforce for workforce logic; vop_poc_nz for study parameters
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Current source prices, marginal versus average cost, no tariff-as-cost assumption.

additional_data_needs.label: Utilities, wellbeing and family outcomes
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Age/condition/instrument compatibility; preserve uncertainty and correlations.
additional_data_needs.access: Published studies or consented primary collection; instrument licences may apply.
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Validated youth measures; separate QALYs, wellbeing and productivity to avoid double counting.

additional_data_needs.label: High-frequency mortality and reporting revisions
additional_data_needs.granularity: jurisdiction × event month/day × release vintage × age
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Occurrence time and availability time are separate; suppressed cells stay suppressed.
additional_data_needs.access: Public tables if adequate; custodian requests otherwise.
additional_data_needs.owner: open_social_data public aggregates; governed environment for restricted detail
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Age-specific frequency, event-vs-reporting lag and sufficient pre/post observations.

additional_data_needs.label: School calendars and education exposure
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Match actual calendars and student exposure; holidays not uniform national treatments.
additional_data_needs.access: Education departments and governed education linkage where needed.
additional_data_needs.owner: open_social_data public calendars; vop_poc_nz governed study
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Separate seasonality, secular trends, pandemic shocks and changes in case ascertainment.

additional_data_needs.label: Digital-policy exposure and implementation
additional_data_needs.granularity: jurisdiction × implementation date × exact eligible age × platform
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Exact age eligibility and sufficient follow-up; broad 15–19 band cannot identify under-16 exposure.
additional_data_needs.access: Public laws and surveys; consented research for user-level behaviour.
additional_data_needs.owner: atlas-health-policy-anz for relevant ANZ evidence; governed study for behaviour
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Do not call an annual series ending near implementation a post-policy evaluation.

additional_data_needs.label: Linked family and sibling outcomes
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Approved pseudonymous linkage only; no person identifiers in public GitHub/HF.
additional_data_needs.access: Stats NZ IDI or relevant AU linkage custodians; approval, secure access and output checking required.
additional_data_needs.owner: approved secure environment; code-only references in existing repos
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Research/ethics approvals, data minimisation, counterfactual design and disclosure review.

additional_data_needs.label: Equity strata and geographic concordances
additional_data_needs.granularity: subnational geography × age × time × agreed subgroup
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Versioned many-to-many boundary crosswalk; no ecological inference of personal identity.
additional_data_needs.access: Official aggregates or governed linkage; culturally appropriate governance before Indigenous analyses.
additional_data_needs.owner: open_social_data public concordances; governed subgroup analysis
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Compatible denominators, small-number privacy, subgroup meaning and prespecified equity weights.

additional_data_needs.label: Classification and coverage validation
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Do not estimate undercount from the incomplete outcome series alone; preserve shared-source dependence.
additional_data_needs.access: Published audits and custodian validation; restrictions may apply.
additional_data_needs.owner: open_social_data for licensed aggregate evidence; vop_poc_nz measurement model
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: External identification or explicit sensitivity bounds, not unlabelled imputation.

additional_data_needs.label: Actual service pathways, capacity and uptake
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Episodes are not unique patients; directory presence is not available capacity.
additional_data_needs.access: Aggregate public tables plus authorised CHHHS/partner extracts; secure linkage where necessary.
additional_data_needs.owner: governed health-service environment; vop_poc_nz aggregate model inputs
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Clinical pathway definitions, permissions, age scope, costs and implementation fidelity.

additional_data_needs.label: Economic decision conventions
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Report health system, government and societal accounting separately.
additional_data_needs.access: Decision-maker protocol and current methodological guidance.
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: Transfers are not automatically net societal costs; separate health value from productivity and avoid double counting.

additional_data_needs.label: Access, travel and out-of-pocket burden
additional_data_needs.join_contract: Validate network/catchment/service availability; preserve rural and age scope.
additional_data_needs.access: Public service/pricing sources and approved patient surveys or linkage.
additional_data_needs.owner: open_social_data public sources; governed data and vop_poc_nz study
additional_data_needs.promotion_gate: A listed provider is not proof of a service, appointment or affordable access.

questions.question: Do child benefits and refundable tax credits reduce youth suicide?
questions.estimand: Age-specific intention-to-treat effect of a defined entitlement reform.
questions.design: Prespecified staggered event study or synthetic control after feasibility assessment.
questions.analysis_gate: Adequate policy timing/exposure variation, pretrends and independent treated clusters; no selection on outcome plots.
questions.decision_output: Policy effect with uncertainty; fiscal cost and health gains reported separately.

questions.question: Do minimum wages and unemployment protections affect youth outcomes through family security?
questions.estimand: Reform effect by prespecified baseline exposure, not realised benefit spending.
questions.design: Quasi-experimental exposure/event study with labour-market and eligibility checks.
questions.analysis_gate: Address labour demand, simultaneous reforms, compositional changes and spillovers.
questions.decision_output: Mortality effect, income mechanism and distributional consequences.

questions.question: Do housing assistance and eviction protections improve youth outcomes?
questions.estimand: Effect of a defined housing-security reform on eligible youth populations.
questions.design: Natural experiment with local housing exposure and appropriate controls.
questions.analysis_gate: Housing strain measures and implementation dates must match geography; no individual causal inference from national correlations.
questions.decision_output: Health gains, housing/fiscal costs and displacement effects.

questions.question: Do social protections buffer youth mortality during economic shocks?
questions.estimand: Interaction between plausibly exogenous shock exposure and prespecified protection.
questions.design: Event study or difference-in-differences with shock/protection measured separately.
questions.analysis_gate: Account for endogenous policy responses, multiple testing and sparse events.
questions.decision_output: Resilience effect and policy-contingent economic consequences.

questions.question: What are the age-specific health and economic consequences of youth suicide?
questions.estimand: Observed YLL and scenario-based avoidable burden, not a causal intervention effect.
questions.design: Descriptive life-table burden model with uncertainty and explicit counterfactuals.
questions.analysis_gate: No value of life inferred from earnings; avoid combining overlapping health-value and productivity totals.
questions.decision_output: Deaths, YLL, optional QALYs and separately accounted economic consequences.

questions.question: How are burden and prevention gains distributed?
questions.estimand: Between-group outcome inequality and changes under explicit allocation rules.
questions.design: Stratified descriptive analysis followed by distributional CEA when effects are qualified.
questions.analysis_gate: Require real subgroup denominators and appropriate governance; national means cannot create subgroup effects.
questions.decision_output: Equity-efficiency frontier and subgroup gains/losses.

questions.question: How do age compatibility, coding and incomplete coverage alter conclusions?
questions.estimand: Change in descriptive estimates and study conclusions under supported measurement alternatives.
questions.design: Source reconciliation, sensitivity bounds and externally identified measurement models.
questions.analysis_gate: Shared source data are not independent validation; no unlabelled completion of missing countries.
questions.decision_output: Coverage ledger, comparability matrix and robustness results.

questions.question: What is the cost of delayed or revised mortality reporting?
questions.estimand: Decision loss and forecast error due to release lag/revisions.
questions.design: Vintage-aware retrospective nowcasting and decision replay.
questions.analysis_gate: No use of future revisions during historical predictions; actual vintage data needed.
questions.decision_output: Reporting-delay loss and candidate surveillance improvements.

questions.question: When is improved surveillance worth its cost?
questions.estimand: EVPI/EVPPI/EVSI and expected net benefit of a specified information investment.
questions.design: Probabilistic decision model with explicit data-generation and sampling-cost models.
questions.analysis_gate: A missing series alone does not identify undercount; information must change a defined decision.
questions.decision_output: Research design, maximum worthwhile spend and ENBS.

questions.question: Which prevention portfolio gives greatest health gain under a defined budget?
questions.estimand: Incremental costs, QALYs and opportunity cost across feasible strategy combinations.
questions.design: CEA/CUA plus constrained portfolio optimisation and probabilistic sensitivity.
questions.analysis_gate: Assess interaction/overlap between programmes; no assumed one-to-one attempt-to-death effect.
questions.decision_output: Efficient strategies, budget feasibility, uncertainty and distribution.

questions.question: Is enhanced aftercare and care continuity cost-effective?
questions.estimand: Incremental outcomes and resource use for eligible post-crisis youth.
questions.design: Trial/natural-experiment evidence synthesis plus pathway model.
questions.analysis_gate: Separate people from repeat events; model follow-up completion and selection into aftercare.
questions.decision_output: ICER/net benefit, uptake requirements and capacity implications.

questions.question: Can multidisciplinary/task-shared youth care improve access and value?
questions.estimand: Outcomes and costs versus actual care at feasible staffing and supervision.
questions.design: Pragmatic service evaluation plus capacity-constrained economic model.
questions.analysis_gate: Safety, scope, supervision and actual clinical effectiveness; cheaper staff are not assumed equivalent.
questions.decision_output: Workforce mix, cost consequences, access and safety thresholds.

questions.question: What funding and workforce are needed to implement prevention at scale?
questions.estimand: Annual payer cash/resource requirements and displaced activity.
questions.design: Undiscounted annual BIA with separately identified economic evaluation outputs.
questions.analysis_gate: Account for ramp-up, fixed costs, limited staff, recurrent funding and eligible population.
questions.decision_output: One-to-five-year cash flow, FTE and implementation scenarios.

questions.question: When do government, health-system and societal rankings disagree?
questions.estimand: Change in preferred strategy and forgone health/equity across perspectives.
questions.design: Reconciled multi-perspective CEA/DCEA and discordance analysis.
questions.analysis_gate: Shared underlying resource ledger; transfer payments and productivity kept distinct.
questions.decision_output: Perspective discordance, cross-sector budget consequences and VOI.

questions.question: Does timing school support around the school calendar improve outcomes?
questions.estimand: Effect of defined support timing, not merely association with school days.
questions.design: High-frequency controlled event study or prospective service trial.
questions.analysis_gate: Annual international mortality cannot identify school-day effects; exact calendars and age scope required.
questions.decision_output: Support calendar, health/education effects and incremental cost.

questions.question: What is the value of school-based prevention including educational outcomes?
questions.estimand: Incremental health, attendance/attainment and resource use by programme.
questions.design: Trial-based economic evaluation with evidence-supported longer-term scenarios.
questions.analysis_gate: Do not monetise education and earnings twice; assess displacement of teaching and support time.
questions.decision_output: CEA and separate education/wellbeing cost-consequence account.

questions.question: How does bereavement affect parent employment, sibling education and family health?
questions.estimand: Causal or carefully qualified longitudinal bereavement effect versus a credible counterfactual.
questions.design: Approved linked cohort with pre-event trajectories and sensitivity analyses.
questions.analysis_gate: Restricted linkage and approvals essential; aggregate mortality cannot answer this.
questions.decision_output: Family spillover estimates for separate inclusion in evaluation.

questions.question: Is family/community postvention good value?
questions.estimand: Incremental family health and functional outcomes versus current support.
questions.design: Pragmatic evaluation plus cost-consequence/utility model.
questions.analysis_gate: Use intervention evidence rather than assuming reversal of all bereavement effects.
questions.decision_output: Postvention value, delivery costs and access requirements.

questions.question: What are the benefits, harms and economic effects of age-based digital policies?
questions.estimand: Effect among precisely eligible ages, including displacement and unequal effects.
questions.design: Prospectively specified policy evaluation with adequate pre/post data.
questions.analysis_gate: Exact eligible age and meaningful post-implementation follow-up; mortality is not the sole endpoint.
questions.decision_output: Health/wellbeing/education/administration cost-consequence analysis.

questions.question: Which rural/remote delivery model reduces unmet need cost-effectively?
questions.estimand: Incremental access, outcomes and costs of feasible outreach, telehealth or shared-care models.
questions.design: Pragmatic comparative service evaluation plus geographic capacity model.
questions.analysis_gate: Validate actual services/capacity, digital exclusion and cultural governance; not directory counts.
questions.decision_output: Delivery model, travel burden, staff requirements and subgroup value.

questions.question: Do lower out-of-pocket costs or changed coverage improve youth outcomes?
questions.estimand: Effect of a specified fee/eligibility reform on access and subsequent outcomes.
questions.design: Eligibility discontinuity or policy natural experiment where assumptions hold.
questions.analysis_gate: Insurance/fee exposure, substitution and concurrent access reforms must be measured.
questions.decision_output: Financial protection, service costs and health effects.

questions.question: Which international results can support an ANZ or CHHHS decision?
questions.estimand: Local incremental net benefit under explicit transportability assumptions.
questions.design: Structured effect/implementation transport, recalibration and uncertainty analysis.
questions.analysis_gate: International baseline mortality is not proof that a local service works; record population and system differences.
questions.decision_output: Local model, applicability limits, evidence priorities and decision sensitivity.

cross_cutting_requirements: Protocol and estimand before outcome-driven model selection.
Preserve registration/occurrence/release dates, age and geographic definitions, source revisions and missingness.
No individual risk prediction, re-identification or reconstruction of suppressed cells.
Predefine uncertainty, missing-data sensitivity, multiplicity and causal identification checks.
Separate observation, modelling and decision conventions; no claims of source independence where upstream data overlap.
Meaningful consumer/lived-experience and culturally appropriate governance for study design and reporting.
